items.description:
The items of the reel, in the order they stand on its ring. One left out is not there; "lock" always is (left out, it comes last).
Read as the shell starts.

Takes a list of words ("sleep", "poweroff", "reboot", "hibernate", "logout" or "lock"). Default: ["sleep","poweroff","reboot","hibernate","logout","lock"]. Read as the shell starts.

rest.description:
The item the reel rests on when the shell starts: a right click fires the item it rests on. One of "items".

Takes "sleep", "poweroff", "reboot", "hibernate", "logout" or "lock". Default: "lock". Read as the shell starts.

sleep.x-wants: a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"]
sleep.description: Takes a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"].

poweroff.x-wants: a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"]
poweroff.description: Takes a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"].

reboot.x-wants: a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"]
reboot.description: Takes a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"].

hibernate.description: Takes a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"].

logout.description: Takes a command as a list of texts, like ["kitty", "-e", "yazi"].

commands.description:
What an item runs instead of its own command, as a list: { "sleep": ["systemctl", "suspend"], "poweroff": ["systemctl", "poweroff"],
"reboot": ["systemctl", "reboot"], "logout": ["hyprctl", "dispatch", "hl.dsp.exit()"] } is what they run now. "hibernate" runs nothing (it
says so in a notification) until it has a command here: ["systemctl", "hibernate"], ["systemctl", "suspend-then-hibernate"]. "lock" is
the lock's own and cannot be changed. With session restore on, the session is still saved first for poweroff, reboot and logout.

Default: {}.

waitForFlourish.description:
Power off, reboot, hibernate and log out wait until their glyph's flourish has played. false: they run at once. true | false.

Takes true or false. Default: true.

leftClickFires.description:
A right click fires the item (scrolling never does). true: a left click fires it too. true | false.

Takes true or false. Default: false.
